'''Sellexith''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Daichyura]] living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic War]] who worked at [[Star Cluster Casino]] as a [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] during a [[Soovada]] event.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sellexith appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the Nightlife event. She was added to the game in update 5.2.2.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
